ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a white-to-black pixel ratio of approximately <0.05 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black field covering >95% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression at the center, approximately 35-45 degrees, dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge, most pronounced on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the distal tips of both fluke lobes, characteristic of barnacle attachment sites or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent horizontal white linear mark on the mid-section of the left lobe, plus several smaller, faint vertical/diagonal disruptions on the central-left area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular pigmentation concentrated on the lateral margins and distal tips of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Sparse distribution of small, circular white punctate marks (specks) visible across the right lobe surface, distinct from water droplet spray.
